home_intro.heading: Feedback on AGRIBALYSE data, from the people who use it
home_intro.lead: If something looks wrong in an AGRIBALYSE food or process, record what you found and which release you used. Other users can check your finding on the same release. The community can then report verified findings to ADEME, which decides what to change.

description: Report an observation about an AGRIBALYSE food or process, check another user’s finding and follow verified feedback to ADEME.
